propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is byte-identical in failure.py and sizing.py, creating a duplication risk that silently leaves one copy stale when the other is updated

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain defined in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py binds it at import time and tests monkeypatch it by string, so re-exporting from failure.py would desynchronize both
A uniqueness guard must match all eight phrases as a conjunction within a single expression, exempt the owner failure.py, honor a comment-marker escape, and fail when a second copy is introduced

Three other proposed consolidations are withdrawn: the retryable-to-exit-code mapping is already centralized in _llm_commands.py, the structured.py message merge was decided against in closed bug injurious-definable-badger, and completion_failures._is_token_exhaustion is a deliberately different third classifier that must remain unchanged

The fix reduces sizing.is_context_limit_error to read failure._CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS via import instead of carrying its own tuple, introducing no import cycle since failure.py imports only rebar.llm.errors
